Training
DektakXT
Overview
Description:
During this modular 2-day course you can improve your skillset on the Bruker Dektak XT system. If you are new to the system or need a refresher, you can choose to stay the two days or participate only in one or two days, depending on your personal requirements. The course covers basic software usage, Stylus selection, Stylus installation, alignment, standard experiments in N-Lite and Safe mode on the first day. A brief look into the analysis functions is also scheduled for day one. On the second day advanced options of the DektakXT are covered. We would start with Calibration, Automation programs, Database setup and Roughness Measurement. 
Agenda:
Day 1:
Introduction to Dektak Profilometry
Vision64 software
DXT Measurement set up
Vision64 software
Stylus and Force selection, Calibration, Step Measurements
Basic Analysis functions
Day 2:
Artifacts
Optimizing scan parameters
Automation programs and Database
Roughness Measurements

Nuestros productos y soluciones están dirigidos a hacer frente a las necesidades cambiantes de una gran diversidad de clientes dedicados a la investigación de ciencias de la vida, productos farmacéuticos, biotecnología, biología celular, investigación clínica, microbiología, diagnóstico in vitro, nanotecnología e investigación en la ciencia de materiales.
